First Class Service in Jaspas Dong Khoi
Apr 2021
We have eaten frequently over the years in Jaspas Dong Khoi, especially since they closed their Hai Ba Trung branch a few years ago. The food is always super tasty and the service is first class, even with the sad departure of our favourite manager, known as The Doctor, to another branch of Jaspas. Favourite meals include the sirloin steak with pepper sauce and fat chips, peas and side salad and the delicious Butter Chicken. The Butter Chicken even rivals and transcends most other Indian restaurants in the city, and that is very significant as we love our Indian food and wouldn't normally eat Indian food in a non Indian restaurant. Jaspas banoffee pie still also remains the best dessert in the city. One of our great many visits remains especially memorable. One of our young Vietnamese friends has very severe cerebral palsy and we took him just before Christmas to join us for a western style Christmas dinner with Christmas pud etc. After we got out of the taxi, our friend struggled, even with us holding him to move towards the restaurant. Both the waiter and waitress saw his walking difficulties and came running out , with big welcoming smiles and took his arm, in a very friendly and natural way, either side of him. I had not asked for this or arranged help so it was lovely and heartwarming to see. Once inside, the waiter in particular kept lingering near our table and often came up to chat to our young friend in Vietnamese in a spontaneous, friendly and gentle way. This made our friend so happy and I could see how much he was enjoying himself, especially that someone was choosing to come and chat to him many times and to figure out what he was saying, as his speech can be very unclear until you get to know how he pronounces things. But this waiter was kind and patient and a very lovely caring man who made our friend's night the most memorable one he had ever experienced. Normally his family doesn't take him out much although he has a very wonderful, loving dad and until now I had only ever taken him to Burger King, Mc Donald's or ice cream parlours so it was his first time in a non fast food restaurant. It was beautiful....the decor, the food, the Christmas spirit that was in Jaspas that night. Later our friend said it was the best night he had ever had. I know that a large part of that was the wonderful caring and attentive waiter, whose name I found out was Vincent. I didn't find out the waitress name unfortunately but she was the lady who flew out of the restaurant to spontaneously help our friend inside, with Vincent, and sha also gave a big cheery smile each time she passed. Hats off to Jaspas Diong Khoi for having some of the nicest most humane caring staff anywhere.
